name: pop-out
title: Pop Out
description: A block pushes up from below and pops the block on top of it into a small hop. Pure CSS keyframes, played once on mount.
author: yui540 <https://github.com/yui540>
docs:
Installed `PopOut`. Import it from `@/components/ui/pop-out` and render `<PopOut key={run} aria-label="A block popping up out of another" />`.

It plays once on mount; change its `key` to play it again.
The keyframes live in the component file and React 19 hoists them into `<head>` once (`<style href precedence>`), so nothing is added to your global CSS. Colors come from the item's own variables (`--pop-out-surface`, `--pop-out-top`, `--pop-out-base`), with the upstream grays as fallbacks.

Reduced motion: no motion; both blocks show their resting state.
